title: ANDS Studio — Operations (registry, portfolio, correspondence, audit)
walkthrough:
You open the Portfolio page under the unified top navigation bar (subtitle "portfolio"). The "Portfolio" heading sits above "Every product dossier in your organisation — module progress, filing gate and fee status at a glance," then a smaller note that every change is captured in the dossier's append-only audit trail — actor and workspace stamped, sequence-numbered, exportable for inspections (open a dossier → Audit). With no data you see "No dossiers yet." and a link "Create one in the dossier manager →."

With dossiers present, an "Export client status report (CSV)" button downloads a spreadsheet, and three summary cards count Dossiers, Ready to file, and Blocked. If any dossier has a deadline within 30 days or overdue, a card appears: "⏳ N dossiers with a deadline in the next 30 days," an optional overdue chip, "soonest first," and up to eight linked dossier chips showing ID, date, a relative label and owner.

Each dossier row shows the ID, title, submission type (plus "· CS-BE" if applicable); an Owner / Client / Due column (missing values read "—" or "none set"); a mini module tower; and ONE primary status chip — "Ready to file," a count like "3/7 modules," or "Blocked." A quiet per-row "Details" expander holds the fee chip ("Fee paid," "Fee waived," or "Fee due" with amount and currency), any litigation clock ("⏱ NOA: 12d for brand to act" or "stay: 8d remaining," each with a provenance popover), and collaboration chips (assignees, open-task count, "⛔ blocked"). Links "Open →" and "Viewer" end the row.

You navigate to the Registry page ("Product registry") with a "Register product +" toggle. A "Record only." notice states that registering or changing status logs a record in your workspace and does not transmit or file anything with Health Canada. Opening the form asks for Product name, Dossier ID, DIN (8 digits, with live validation — blank reads "Issued by Health Canada at NOC — leave blank until then"), Country, and Drug type; "Register product →" submits. When any registration is marketable a "Right-to-Sell deadlines" card lists per-DIN due dates (October 1, overdue flagged). Registrations list as rows, or "No registrations yet." An "Annual notification checklist" card (with the current year) records who signed each tick and when; ticked items strike through with a "✓ signed by … · UTC" line.

The Correspondence page is headed "Correspondence & notices" with a "Record only." notice: everything here logs a record and does not transmit; filing happens only through the guided journey's transmit step (CESG). A "Dossier" field pre-fills with your first dossier (placeholder "e123456"); pressing "Open" reveals three stacked panels. The "Notice inbox" records an SDN/SAL/SRL/NOD/NON/NOC — ingesting one advances the DSTS lifecycle, files inbound correspondence and surfaces the response window; if no lifecycle exists it offers a "Start lifecycle" form. The "Correspondence hub" lists every logged letter (kind, direction, subject, date) with a "Log correspondence +" form and a kind filter. A "Form V / NOA register" tracks the PM(NOC) statutory clocks. Until you pick a dossier: "Pick a dossier to see its correspondence, notices and NOA clocks."

Opening any dossier's Audit page shows the "Audit Trail" — the durable, append-only Part-11 record, newest first, with Refresh and "Export audit report (CSV)." Each event shows a category chip, action, sequence number, timestamp, a "by" actor chip and a compact detail line; a footer counts events, noting they are mirrored to the central governance trail.
